items.title: Pay invoice for wallbox installation
items.quote: Zahlbar innerhalb von 8 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug auf unser Konto bei der Musterbank AG.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 16.10.2026 (a Friday). The period is '8 Tage ab Rechnungsdatum', an event-triggered period, so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (16.10.) is not counted; counting starts on 17.10.2026. Eight days later (16.10. + 8 days) falls on 24.10.2026, which is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, when a payment is due on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline moves to the next business day: Monday, 26.10.2026 (not a public holiday in NRW).

items.title: Keep invoice for two years (statutory retention for construction-related private service)
items.quote: Bitte bewahren Sie diese Rechnung zwei Jahre auf (§ 14b Abs. 1 Satz 5 UStG).
items.computation: § 14b Abs. 1 Satz 5 UStG obliges a private recipient of a service connected to immovable property (here: installation of a wallbox in the garage) to retain the invoice for two years, the period running from receipt of the invoice. Taking the invoice date 16.10.2026 as the starting point (exact receipt date unknown, assumed same day), two years later is 16.10.2028.
